name: Vampire - Children of the Night (1/Day) - Failures
description: Flavor text for failures a action

results.text: The summons falters, a gust of wind scattering the creatures before they fully materialize, leaving only echoes of fury.
A mocking silence answers the vampire’s command as the night remains eerily still, refusing to yield its beasts.
The summoned creatures shriek in agony as daylight sears them away, their forms dissolving into nothingness.
A futile ripple of energy fades, the beasts never fully manifesting, leaving the vampire alone against its foes.
The night betrays its master, denying him his children and leaving only the cold embrace of defeat.
